items.caption:
Sleep paralysis: why you can't move when you wake up.
In REM sleep your muscles are switched off, and sometimes the mind wakes first. About 8% of people have had it. Scary but short; if it's frequent or worrying, talk to a doctor.

After 17 hours awake, you test like you drank.
In a 2000 study, 17 to 19 hours without sleep left people as impaired as a 0.05% blood alcohol level on some tests (Williamson & Feyer).
